title: POST /api/dev/runs request body
description: Shape only. The route's own 'project with project_id, stage_selection and input_values is required' stays a 400 (src/app/api/dev/runs/route.ts:17-22).

project.description: Unknown keys are accepted — in the project, in metadata, in stage_selection and in each input_values entry: the dev console pastes free-form project JSON (src/app/dev/page.tsx:25,45-53). The route's own 'project with project_id, stage_selection and input_values is required' 400 still guards the body.

metadata.description: Known keys are typed; unknown keys are accepted (free-form paste) except the prototype keys.

stage_selection.description: Known keys are typed; unknown keys are accepted (free-form paste).

input_values.description: Unknown keys are accepted: the dev console pastes free-form project JSON. The prototype keys are not: an input id must never be able to set a prototype (src/domain/project-edits.ts:134).

additionalProperties.description: Unknown keys are accepted: the dev console pastes free-form project JSON.

state.description: Unconstrained on purpose: the state vocabulary is the domain's.
